correction.how_the_new_value_was_derived: By extracting the section under the corrected boundary from the ADR as it stood at commit 868d8ae, the opening commit, read out of git history rather than from the working tree. The disclosure text is byte-identical at that commit and now: 3965 characters, sha256 51c76e7bdee840bc70c37afdb15ed9e57df12eb64ab536f73fb4df7fc80e678f. The correction fixes the detector, not the thing detected.
correction.reason: The original hash was taken over text extracted from the control-run heading to the '## Post-project findings' heading. That boundary is not fixed: every section appended before Post-project findings enlarged the extracted region, so the hash changed whenever the record grew, which is the opposite of the intent. The boundary is now the next '## ' heading.

note: SHA-256 of everything that existed before the holdout was opened, taken at the moment of opening. Once a holdout number exists there is pressure to revisit the control-window write-up, and nothing else detects that. These hashes are the detector. The ADR entry covers the control-run disclosure section only, so the record can keep growing while that section cannot change.
